_comment: Use-case config 1. Two-channel edge-delay: measure the delay from the CH1 falling edge to the CH2 falling edge. CH1 5 V/div (use 10 for 24 V calibrations), CH2 2 V/div. Plain numbers in the scope's native units: vertical_scale in V/div, vertical_position in divisions, trigger_position in %, record_length in points, trigger_level in volts (or "half_battery" = half of battery_voltage). The capture window is NOT stored in the config; set it per call with configure_scope(..., duration_s=SECONDS), which sets s/div = duration_s/10. WINDOW: pass duration_s=20 to configure_scope for this test (20 s total = 2 s/div x 10).
